notes.title: Small Patch (Mid September 2025)
notes.content:
[h1][u]Change Log[/u][/h1][p]Before we disappear and start working on the next major update, we wanted to create a quick update to reflect the original vision of the half-way update. There were many bugs and missing features that somehow broke on the steam export... Cirno scolded us for being idiots and told us to fix it ASAP.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]///Warning Warning Warning///[/i][/b][/p][p]This change log contains major spoilers. We'll do our best to keep things vague but we highly recommend playing stage 3 first before reading this change log.[/p][p][b][i]///Warning Warning Warning///[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h2][i]Level 2 Specific Changes[/i][/h2][p]2-7 marisa text fixed[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Level 3 Specific Changes[/i][/h2][p]Overall balancing of the level slightly changed. Most changes involved only Hard and Lunatic.
Reimu's stage is a great roller coaster of emotions but there's not enough pressure to beat the level on hard and lunatic yet. With difficulties feeling "similar", values have been slightly changed to give a more distinct feel for these difficulties.

We also moved the spawn location of Cirno and the B for the first part of the level. As much as the intensity of being so close to the boss was a great emotion, there were some moments that felt unfair to the average player. This was a comment our team had before PAXWest and we've been debating it for a while. But after seeing all the gameplay, we agreed this is a better location.[/p][p][/p][h2][i]In addition:[/i][/h2][p]3-3 A certain condition results in a new attack that was missing[/p][p]3-3 One of the conditions resulted in nothing happening, that's now been fixed[/p][p]3-3 Conditions have a better RNG system for which condition is selected[/p][p]3-4 Cirno no longer goes out of bounds...we hope...this is a super tricky bug[/p][p]3-6 Missing Gimmick has been added. This is a major change for the attack.[/p][p]3-7 Certain thing doesn't get stuck and do nothing anymore[/p][p]3-7 Attacks now react to certain situations. Keeping this vague for spoilers.[/p][p]SFX added through out the level[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Changes outside of levels[/i][/h2][p]3 new tips added to reflect new game mechanics[/p][p]Cutscene music missing bug fixed.[/p][p]1-up animation cleaned up with sfx[/p][p]Missing attack names should appear on the bottom right again[/p][p]A demo mode for conventions is put in the game (but may have issues)[/p][p][/p][h1][u]Dreamhack Atlanta 2025[/u][/h1][p]As a reminder, we're invading Dreamhack Atlanta Oct 31 - Nov 2!
We can't guarantee we'll have something new to share but we can promise that our Strongest Gamer competition will be back.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope everyone can stop by and help us share Cirno to the world![/p][p]
[u][b]Use the code TOUHOU for 15% off!!![/b][/u][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041499/9fa3260b607bdbd49401c8e7dfec84c47bac5d0b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][u]Thank you![/u][/h1][p]Once again, thank you everyone for supporting our fairy. She's trying her best~ If you haven't, consider leaving us a Steam Review! It'll help with the algorithm since we're really hard to find right now[/p]

notes.title: CIRNO DAY GAME UPDATE (Sept 2025 Newsletter)
notes.content:
[h1]~~~~~~HAPPY CIRNO DAY 9/9!!!!!~~~~~~[/h1][p][/p][p]First of all, go to your nearest Cirno, and give her all the headpats. This is her special day and she deserves all the love around the world![/p][p]It's been a long time coming and we're finally ready to push our first update for our game. We've been working quite hard the last month to make this Cirno Day update amazing and hope you all can join us in celebrating the best day of the year. But before we get to it...[/p][h2]
PAX Results[/h2][p]Thank you all for visiting our amazing tiny booth at PAX West 2025!

Overall, the reception of the game was very solid. We also found tons of bugs and efficiencies that needed to be made thanks to you all. We gave away T-Shirts, Postcards for Daiyousei, and even saw a Cirno cosplayer stop by. What a WIN!

We want to do PAX again but due to the cost, we'll have to wait and see if we can secure more funding first.[/p][p][/p][p]Regardless, I believe we are the first ever "Touhou exclusive" booth at PAXWest and I think we did a great job representing![/p][p][/p][h2]Change Log[/h2][p]Here is what you've been waiting for. This is the change log for Touhou Danmaku Maze!!! This change log won't contain every change made. This update is almost a re-overhaul of the game and we hope you enjoy. Here are the main changes to expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]Stage 2 is fully animated and SFXd[/b][/p][list][*][p]As you may have saw in the last update, the art was still in the beta pixel art format. We use this as a general guide to determine what the art should look like but it's easily a placeholder. Now the level feels fully fleshed out with some amazing GFX to illustrate the story.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Overworld is now a hub world[/b][/p][list][*][p]The original vision of this game was similar to an arcade game where levels are played back to back. We realized in testing that this game is stupid difficult and longer than most arcade games. Restarting a run due to some "gimmick" attacks made the experience impossible to enjoy. Now there is a hub world where you can choose any level you want!
(Obviously stages 4-6 are not available yet)[/p][/*][*][p]In addition, we added some flavor text and the ability to easily see what trophy you got in the stage. It's a general game philosophy we want to push. Collecting trophies is the name of the game![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Records screen placeholder implemented[/b][/p][list][*][p]This screen will soon become the core experience for most players. We really want to incentivize players to collect all the gold trophies. Now there is an easy place to see all your results in each difficulty. Can you collect all the golds?[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Japanese translations in progress[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adding translations was a fail on our part. With the drastic amount of changes to the game constantly, it wasn't viable for us to add the translations. Most of the translations end up incorrect due to the constant changes in level design, story, etc. For now, we put some of the translations on but note that this is a work in progress. You should be able to enjoy the 1st and 2nd stage in Japanese.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stage 3 is fully playable with scary shrine lady[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stage 3 is finally available for playing! There may be some animation/story issues but the gameplay is what we focused on first. You're going to find that this stage is danmaku heavy and you may see alot of "tributes" to older games. I would say that this stage isn't as "puzzle" heavy but there will be some clever routing.[/p][/*][*][p]We are aware of some cutscene failures that didn't make it in time...we really tried to make all the changes happen but Cirno said the game had to be updated on Cirno day. We'll hopefully get that fixed in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]If you're worried that Stage 3 is too danmaku, don't worry. Stage 4 will be VERY puzzle heavy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stage 1 Snowball Flurry is changed[/b][/p][list][*][p]We hear you, machine gun daiyousei was boring and repetitive on easy and normal. It's just more of the same. We get it. It's now an actual flurry attack now! To be honest, since it's the first stage, we can't push the player too much. If we go off the rails at the start of the game, the poor player is going to get destroyed and demotivated. [/p][/*][*][p]This new attack will force the player to learn to stop, read ahead and it's MUCH harder to keep your score combo up. We'll keep an eye on this and see if we need to lower the score requirements due to this change but I don't think it'll change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Continue System Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]In our previous build, we didn't want to punish the player but now that we have level select, we can turn on the burners and make the game harder. Each difficulty has a different amount of continues you can use.[/p][list][*][p]Easy - Unlimited Continues[/p][list][*][p]We want easy to be completely accessible. You can continue as much as you want so you can enjoy the story[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Normal - 9 Continues[/p][list][*][p]We also want normal to be accessible by everyone. Most people will never use 9 continues but if you're an easy mode player who wants to try something slightly harder, we want you to give it a shot.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Hard - 3 Continues[/p][list][*][p]This is the core Touhou Danmaku Maze experience. Not only is this difficulty the original standard of the game, we also want this to be a completion of skill. 3 continues will be enough for you to learn the patterns but you won't be able to brute force through everything.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Lunatic - No Continues[/p][list][*][p]We want Lunatic to feel "Lunatic". This 1cc challenge is very difficult and is the ultimate challenge of the game. This is for the hardcore and we use this brutal continue system to ensure it stays that way.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]and more quality of life features![/b][/p][list][*][p]Once again, we can't list every thing that we've added. (We also are scared of the amount of bugs people will find...) Regardless, we really wanted wanted to clean up the core experience. We can't even remember EVERY change but here are just some extra things we've added for the player.[/p][list][*][p]1up Effect[/p][/*][*][p]Cut-scene Dialog won't skip if you press button, instead, it'll finish the line first.[/p][/*][*][p]Normal Stage 2-2 & 2-3 Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Empty medal circle appears if you get no medal[/p][/*][*][p]Added "How To Play" cards at menu. (Great for expos and conventions for us)[/p][/*][*][p]Cut-scene Dialog can be skipped now[/p][/*][*][p]All medal thresholds have been re-balanced and now consistent[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities are hidden until we've properly balanced them[/p][/*][*][p]Settings got a slight slight cleanup[/p][/*][*][p]Vibration beta in progress! Play with a controller and feel the game![/p][/*][*][p]Damage Quips are back? (May have issues still)[/p][/*][*][p]and a flood of bugs that got squashed![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Sales And Bundle[/h2][p]Unfortunately, we can't run a sale within 30 days of a previous sale. We had our sale with PAX West so we can't promote Cirno Day with a sale...sorry.[/p][p][/p][p][i]For future reference as well, we have no intentions of selling the game with a sale over 19% unless contractually obligated. In addition, please remember that we intend to raise all the prices once the game is complete.[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Closing Thoughts[/h1][p]Everyone on our team from Ice Fall Creative have been working tirelessly to make this Cirno game a reality. Yes, we get burned out, and yes, we have no funding so this is a passion project currently. It happens but here's proof that we can make progress.[/p][p]All hail our adorable ice fairy.[/p]

Cirno can't wait to show off everything that's changed:[/p][list][*][p]Stage 2 is now finally animated and SFX'd[/p][/*][*][p]The overworld is now a hub world! Select the level you want![/p][/*][*][p]A placeholder records option is now available! Try to collect all the trophies and medals![/p][/*][*][p]Japanese translations in progress. You can see some of the translations now![/p][/*][*][p]Stage 3 with scary shrine lady is fully playable! (Art will be updated at a later time)[/p][/*][*][p]and more quality of life features![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Our previous update was very demo based but these changes will really give this game a better experience~ Do you think you have what it takes to get the gold trophy?[/p][p][/p][h3]PAX West Booth and Secret Preview[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041499/73b325e95a58289e83b4796e71ec641698ac4b47.png"][/img][/h3][p]Did you see our X post about Touhou Danmaku Maze? notes.title: July 2025 Newsletter
notes.content:
[h1]Announcements![/h1][p]You want news? You got it![/p][p]We've been really busy with life that last few weeks so we apologize that updates are not at the speed you may prefer. Regardless, we're working in the background and here's your July 2025 newsletter![/p][p][i](I blame a certain monkey bonzana game taking alot of time recently...)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45041499/1ebe3de4984eaf6ecaabfecc623b040f57911b3f.png"][/img][/p][h3]PAX West 2025[/h3][p]It's our first big convention and we are excited to share our game to fans of gaming! What are we doing this year? I can promise that our "Strongest Fairy" competition will be returning plus we will be giving out some rare swag. We will be posting a special PAX West newsletter 1 week before the convention to give everyone enough time to plan for this event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Stage 3 Update[/h3][p]Stage 3 has taken us awhile and we ran into alot of issues. It's quite "ambitious" compared to the first 2 stages. We posted a quick teaser but that's all we have to say for now...more soon![/p][p][/p][h3]First Collaboration?!?[/h3][p]To wrap things up, we have a special collaboration in the works! Our team has submitted assets and we are in a really good spot. We can't announce when this will take place but we'll make an announcement once the collaboration is available. We can't wait for you to try selling snowcones in this unique way~![/p][h3][/h3][h1]Ending Notes[/h1][p]Our August newsletter is going be much larger and I think everyone is going to enjoy the new changes!
See you funky fairy~![/p]

notes.title: June 2025 Newsletter
notes.content:
[h1]Thank You![/h1][p]Before we get started, our team wants to thank each and everyone who took the dive into our game. We have put years of work into this and it's amazing to give everyone their first taste into a very unique game. Thank you~[/p][p]Our team took a few weeks off to recover and we're back into the grind again. [/p][p][i](This is partially my fault. I bought the entire team some game about a girl who stole time in a life about fantasy, then we got suckered into some ink shooting squid game, some world racing game with karts, some Pinocchio DLC stuff, and I'm already waiting to play a sequel shipping walking simulator game featuring beaches...)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Included below is our first newsletter for our players.[/p][h3]
Animazement[/h3][p]Thank you everyone who saw us at Animazement 2025! We had an absolute blast announcing our early access and taking over the entire convention! From digital banners, guide book advertisements, rare T-shirts, our demo booth, and even Cir9 blasting Touhou music at the rave, we went all out![/p][p]We can't express how much we appreciate your support and hanging out with our team. We also recorded all the gameplay and watched over 6 days worth of footage to learn how to make a better experience. Everyone was a great help and we can't wait to make the game better.[/p][p]Our next convention is already booked and it will be announced at a later time. (It's our biggest ever!!!)
[/p][h3]Upcoming Details[/h3][p]As stated in our store page, Our intentions are to complete all 6 stages similar to any other Touhou game. Our roadmap will take place one stage at a time until that is met. We have some general timelines but we will keep those vague for the time being.

[b]Update 1 - The 3rd Stage Incident:[/b]
For everyone who played our early access, we left a sneak peek into our newest 3rd stage. Many of you have already guessed who it but I can promise this stage is going to be something special.
In this upcoming update, we are hoping for the following:[/p][list][*][p]Stage 3 Playable[/p][list][*][p]We hope you enjoyed the teaser but our goal is to have the whole stage playable. We can't wait to show off the major gimmicks in this stage and we promise Touhou fans will go crazy for the finale.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Stage 2 Art Changed[/p][list][*][p]As of right now, Stage 2 is mostly complete but there are some placeholders as well as much of the BG art is still in a pixel form. We have already started redrawing the assets and are hoping to have this stage 100% complete by the next major update.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Records Screen Placeholder[/p][list][*][p]We want to start giving players a fun reason to replay the game. With this update, players can start attempting to collect all the gold medals and attempt for that difficult gold trophy in all the stages and all the difficulties.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Update 2:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stage 4 Playable[/p][list][*][p]While the entire game is already planned out, many of the small details are still being worked on. Our 4th stage has been fully written out and we can promise you won't be ready for this stage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Minigame - Cirno: The Master Grand[/p][list][*][p]We have a new mini-game in the works. It's still the same game play but in a completely new style. Can you become the Master Grand? (Yes, it's a parody. Yes, it's hard. Yes, there's no danmaku. Yes, Cirno is still the main character.)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Current Issues[/h3][p][b]The game is blacked out on Steam Deck[/b][/p][p]As of right now, our game has not been tested with Steam Deck. We have full intentions on getting compatability with this system but it likely won't happen until the full game is complete. I'd expect a fully working version when v1.0 is released.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Abilities are not working[/b][/p][p]To start off, we agree. We left 1 abilitity in the game to allow early access players to get a taste of the abilities but they are not fully complete.[/p][p]We purposely locked away all the abilities as many are unbalanced, not working as intended, or causing players to have confusion on its function. Our goal is that abilities are a way to "break" the rules of the game. In return though, certain elements of the game will be immune to certain abilities. This will create a Pro/Con to each ability for each stage giving you the chance to figure out which ability is best for you.[/p][p]I suspect within the next major update, the first ability will be fixed and appropriately tuned for each difficulty.[/p][p][/p][p][b]These Potions Suck![/b][/p][p]Marisa's Potion phase is quite difficult and many of you at Animazement met the dreaded Game Over screen way too much. In a following update, I suspect that there will be an easier crystal collection pattern as well as a slight nerf to the potion locations in Normal mode. Easy, Hard, and Lunatic are still working as intended.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Where's Japanese[/b][/p][p]Unfortunately, our Japanese patch wasn't ready in time for the convention. We are currently working on getting some form of the patch. Hopefully in the next major update.[/p][p][/p][h1]Ending Notes[/h1][p]Thank you all for joining us on this journey. We have put so much work into this to make this a success and we hope to continue making this game. Thank you and looking forward to the next update in the next month or two~

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us on Discord![/p]
